help.introMessage: Hello! This is Trellify — a bot for notifications about events from Trello. To be able to use our app, please, follow these steps
steps: **Register on the Trellify website**: Visit our [website]({websiteUrl}) and create an account.
**Connect your Trello profile**: Log in to Trello and link your account with Trellify.
**Connect your Telegram account**: Use this bot to link your Telegram account for receiving notifications.
**Set up notifications**: Enable notifications for the boards you want to monitor in the Trellify settings.
help.closingMessage: If you have any questions, reach out to support.
